info.title: Aimo Agent Gateway
info.description:
An open interface through which an external purchasing agent works with a food-service
wholesaler: look up products, get fixed-price offers, place an order, and have a human approve
whatever exceeds the agent's mandate.

**The flow**

1. `GET /v1/mandate`: what this agent may decide on its own.
2. `GET /v1/products`: search the static catalog (no rate-limited calls behind it).
3. `POST /v1/requests`: state a need; the answer is a ranked list of orderable options, each
   with the mandate's verdict (`auto_approve`, `needs_approval` or `deny`).
4. `POST /v1/orders`: commit to one option. The order is `confirmed`, or held as
   `pending_approval` until a human decides at the approval desk.
5. `GET /v1/orders/{id}/audit`: the human-readable record of what happened and why.

The same operations are available as MCP tools at `/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).

Errors follow RFC 9457 (`application/problem+json`). Agent endpoints need
`Authorization: Bearer <agent token>`. Deciding an order or changing a mandate needs the personal
key of a person the buyer named as approver (`Authorization: Bearer <approver key>`): the gateway
records who decided from the key, never from a name sent with the request. In production the key
is the buyer's own sign-in.

ApprovalDecision.title: ApprovalDecision
ApprovalDecision.description: Who decides is not part of the decision: it is the person the approver key belongs to.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The agent whose orders and rules this person decides

Approver.title: Approver
Approver.description: A person the buyer named to decide what its agent may not decide alone.

hash.title: Hash
hash.description: SHA-256 over this event and the previous event's hash

total.title: Total
total.description: EUR without VAT, over the orders that are still active

order_by.title: Order By
order_by.description: Earliest order cut-off in the basket

left_out.title: Left Out
left_out.description: Needs of the list that could not be filled

Basket.title: Basket
Basket.description: Several orders decided as one: confirmed together, or held together for a human.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: A request from request_options, e.g. PR-0001

option_id.title: Option Id
option_id.description: The option of that request to order

title.title: Title
title.description: What the basket is for, in a few words

note.title: Note
note.description: Why these options. Kept in the audit trail

left_out.title: Left Out
left_out.description: Needs that could not be filled, so the buyer sees them. Other requests without an order since the agent's previous order are closed as replaced

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The agent whose orders and rules this person decides

link.title: Link
link.description: The kitchen view, signed in as this person

asked.title: Asked
asked.description: The need, in the buyer's words where given

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: A request of a need that is not in the basket

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, in the buyer's terms. Defaults to what the gateway found

max_autonomous_spend.title: Max Autonomous Spend
max_autonomous_spend.description: EUR without VAT the agent may commit on its own per delivery day. Orders it placed alone for the same day count together, so splitting an order gains nothing. Spend a human approved does not count. Above the limit a human must approve

hard_max_order_total.title: Hard Max Order Total
hard_max_order_total.description: EUR without VAT. Above this the order is refused outright

allow_substitutes.title: Allow Substitutes
allow_substitutes.description: May the agent accept a substitute alone

substitute_max_price_increase_pct.title: Substitute Max Price Increase Pct
substitute_max_price_increase_pct.description: Largest price increase per litre/kg a substitute may carry

allow_outside_preferences.title: Allow Outside Preferences
allow_outside_preferences.description: May the agent accept, alone, a product outside the buyer's stated preferences (label, brand, origin) when nothing that meets them can be delivered

allow_partial.title: Allow Partial
allow_partial.description: May the agent accept a partial quantity alone

allow_late.title: Allow Late
allow_late.description: May the agent accept late delivery alone

overage_tolerance_pct.title: Overage Tolerance Pct
overage_tolerance_pct.description: Largest overshoot of the quantity caused by pack sizes

forbidden_allergens.title: Forbidden Allergens
forbidden_allergens.description: Substances no ordered product may contain or possibly contain

allowed_categories.title: Allowed Categories
allowed_categories.description: Category codes the agent may buy from alone. Null: all

Mandate.title: Mandate
Mandate.description: What a buyer lets its agent decide alone. Enforced by the wholesaler side on every order.

query.title: Query
query.description: Words that must all appear in the product name or brand

exclude_terms.title: Exclude Terms
exclude_terms.description: Words that must not appear in the product name

free_from.title: Free From
free_from.description: Substances the product must be declared free from: lactose, gluten, milk, eggs, soy, wheat, nuts, peanuts, fish, crustaceans, molluscs, sesame, celery, mustard, sulphites, lupin

exclude_allergens.title: Exclude Allergens
exclude_allergens.description: Substances the product must not declare as contained or possibly contained

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels the product must carry, e.g. EU_ORGANIC_FARMING

text.title: Text
text.description: The buyer's original wording, kept verbatim for the audit trail

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: A specific product that is wanted. Other products are then substitutes.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: L, KG or SALES_UNIT. Also accepts litres, dl, ml, g, units

prefer.title: Prefer
prefer.description: What to rank options by when several fit

Need.title: Need
Need.description: What the buyer wants, in structured form. The agent translates the buyer's words into it.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the offer has this status, in plain words

on_time.title: On Time
on_time.description: Delivered on or before the requested date

unit_price.title: Unit Price
unit_price.description: EUR per sales unit, without VAT

comparison_price.title: Comparison Price
comparison_price.description: EUR per comparison unit, without VAT

content_per_unit.title: Content Per Unit
content_per_unit.description: Requested units (L or KG) contained in one sales unit

content_source.title: Content Source
content_source.description: Where content_per_unit comes from: the price list's comparison price, or the net content declared in the product data when the price list has none

logistic_model.title: Logistic Model
logistic_model.description: Stock: quantity is known. Terminal: supplier warehouse, not known

available_units.title: Available Units
available_units.description: Sales units in stock. Null when not limited or not known

order_by.title: Order By
order_by.description: Order cut-off for the delivery date

order_step.title: Order Step
order_step.description: Order quantity step, in sales units

units_needed.title: Units Needed
units_needed.description: Sales units covering the full need

units_offered.title: Units Offered
units_offered.description: Sales units that can be supplied

quantity_offered.title: Quantity Offered
quantity_offered.description: Supplied amount in the need's unit

is_substitute.title: Is Substitute
is_substitute.description: Differs from the specifically requested product

listed_substitute.title: Listed Substitute
listed_substitute.description: Named as a substitute by the wholesaler

similarity.title: Similarity
similarity.description: How close a substitute's name is to the requested product, 0-1

unmet_preferences.title: Unmet Preferences
unmet_preferences.description: Stated preferences (label, brand, origin) this product does not meet

differences.title: Differences
differences.description: How a substitute differs from the requested product

price_delta_pct.title: Price Delta Pct
price_delta_pct.description: Price per litre/kg compared with the requested product, percent

Offer.title: Offer
Offer.description: One product priced and checked for availability against a need. Prices are fixed.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: best: exactly as asked. better: full and on time with a compromise (substitute or split). good: partial quantity or late delivery

outside_preferences.title: Outside Preferences
outside_preferences.description: Contains a product that does not meet a stated preference

proof.title: Proof
proof.description: The wholesaler's signature over this option's products, quantities, prices, delivery date and origin: a JWS (EdDSA). Anyone can verify it with the keys at /.well-known/jwks.json, without trusting the party that relayed the offer

Option.title: Option
Option.description: One concrete way to fulfil the need. The agent orders by option id.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Amount covered, in the need's unit

unmet_preferences.title: Unmet Preferences
unmet_preferences.description: Stated preferences (label, brand, origin) this product does not meet

delivery_reliability.title: Delivery Reliability
delivery_reliability.description: Historic share of ordered quantity delivered, 0-1

carbon_kg_co2e_per_kg.title: Carbon Kg Co2E Per Kg
carbon_kg_co2e_per_kg.description: Average footprint of the product group, kg CO2e per kg

agent_note.title: Agent Note
agent_note.description: The agent's stated reason for this choice

basket_id.title: Basket Id
basket_id.description: Set when the order was placed together with others, as one decision

basket_title.title: Basket Title
basket_title.description: What the basket is for, in a few words

note.title: Note
note.description: Why the agent chose this option. Kept in the audit trail

PolicyDecision.title: PolicyDecision
PolicyDecision.description: The mandate applied to one option: what happens if the agent orders it.

id.title: Id
id.description: Product code, used in every other call

name.title: Name
name.description: English name, or Finnish when no English name exists

names.title: Names
names.description: Name by language code (fi, en, sv)

category.title: Category
category.description: Wholesaler category code (names are not published)

gtin.title: Gtin
gtin.description: GS1 GTIN of the sales unit

sales_unit.title: Sales Unit
sales_unit.description: Unit the product is priced and ordered in

units.title: Units
units.description: Packaging unit -> size in base units

lot_size.title: Lot Size
lot_size.description: Order quantity step, in sales units

contains.title: Contains
contains.description: GS1 allergen codes the product contains

may_contain.title: May Contain
may_contain.description: GS1 allergen codes the product may contain

substitutes.title: Substitutes
substitutes.description: Substitute product codes listed by the wholesaler

delivery_reliability.title: Delivery Reliability
delivery_reliability.description: Historic share of ordered quantity delivered, 0-1

carbon_kg_co2e_per_kg.title: Carbon Kg Co2E Per Kg
carbon_kg_co2e_per_kg.description: Average footprint of the product group, kg CO2e per kg

net_content.title: Net Content
net_content.description: Declared net content of one base unit, in KG and/or L (GS1 product data)

server_time.title: Server Time
server_time.description: Wholesaler clock used for cut-off checks

funnel.title: Funnel
funnel.description: How the catalog was narrowed down to the options, step by step

excluded.title: Excluded
excluded.description: Matching products that cannot be ordered, with reasons

closed_as.title: Closed As
closed_as.description: Set when a basket was placed without this request. left_out: the agent could not fill the need and reported it. superseded: a working step the agent replaced

basket_id.title: Basket Id
basket_id.description: The basket that closed this request

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of matching products before the limit is applied

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Categories of the matches, largest first: use one to narrow the search

HTTPBearer.description: Token the wholesaler issued to this agent

ApproverKey.description: Personal key of a person the buyer named to approve. In production: the buyer's own sign-in
